PARENTAL LEAVE POLICY

Purpose
This policy describes paid leave for employees who become parents through birth, adoption or foster care.

Leave Entitlement
Primary caregivers receive 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave. Secondary caregivers receive 6 weeks of fully paid leave. Leave can be taken within the first year after the child arrives.

Notice
Employees should notify Human Resources at least 30 days before the planned start of leave whenever possible.

Benefits
Health insurance and retirement contributions continue unchanged during parental leave, and employees return to the same or an equivalent position.
